description: This file contains utility functions for managing TypeScript files in a repository, including resolving repository root directories, collecting TypeScript files from specified paths, detecting test-like files, and other file utility operations.

methods.name: getTypeScript
methods.description: Lazily loads and caches the TypeScript module.

methods.name: resolveRepoRoot
methods.description: Resolves the root directory of the repository based on an import URL.

methods.name: resolveSourceRoots
methods.description: Generates source root paths within the repository.

methods.name: isTestLikeTypeScriptFile
methods.description: Checks if a given TypeScript file is a test or test utility based on suffixes.

methods.name: collectTypeScriptFiles
methods.description: Recursively collects TypeScript files from a target path, optionally including test files.

methods.name: collectTypeScriptFilesFromRoots
methods.description: Collects TypeScript files from multiple source roots.

methods.name: collectFileViolations
methods.description: Analyzes files within source roots for violations using a provided predicate.

methods.name: toLine
methods.description: Converts a node position to a line number in the source file.

methods.name: getPropertyNameText
methods.description: Extracts text from property names if they are identifiers or literals.

methods.name: unwrapExpression
methods.description: Removes parentheses and type assertions from expressions to get the underlying expression.

methods.name: collectCallExpressionLines
methods.description: Collects the line numbers of call expressions within a source file.

methods.name: isDirectExecution
methods.description: Checks if the script is being run directly as the main module.

methods.name: runAsScript
methods.description: Runs a main function if the script is executed directly.
